text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My legs—they feel so light!
It's as if my heart is dancing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My hometown used to just be full of stiff, uptight memories.
But now—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH!)

Riding the high of sightseeing,
Mejiro Palmer ran a brilliant race in the Hakodate Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Alrighty, to celebrate Palmer-chin's explosive run☆
With the million-poyo night view in the background~!"

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyyy☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I think the striking shots turned out great,
but is it still missing something?
choice_data_list: Really? I got some good photos, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Nooo, there's still something missing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come over here and join in, Trainer.
It's boring being the only one stuck taking photos.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally♪
Wanna snap a selfie with the three of us~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Get in closer, wrap your arms around each other's shoulders,
and let's goooooo☆★☆!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, this is it!
That's how it's gotta be!

Looking to the side, I saw Mejiro Palmer
smiling with the brightest, most radiant look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, if I can run the way I did today,
then the autumn season will surely...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, the next goal is...
The goal is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: At the Kikuka Sho!!

Mejiro Palmer steeled her resolve.
Seeing the slight furrow in her brow...
choice_data_list: No, let's not make the Kikuka Sho our goal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A smile?! Ah...!

"She's still bound by a sense of obligation that she 'has to run.'
In that state, we cannot say this is a goal Mejiro Palmer chose proactively."
choice_data_list: Let's save the target race... for next year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Next year, huh~. Isn't that pretty far away?
Honestly, I'd prefer something a bit sooner...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Still, Palmer-chin, you still don't really get it, do you? Like, what you actually want to do besides running and all that?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I guess you're right. Today was
fun in its own way, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I really don't understand anything yet, do I?
Especially my own feelings.

After discussion, our next target race was set
for the Nikkei Shinshun Hai at the start of the Senior year.
"If Mejiro Palmer keeps running, I'm sure her heart will be set by then."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer!
This summer, to get to know myself better—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's play and play and play all we want!
Right here in Hokkaido!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hokkaido...?
Hanging out sounds fun, but why are you limiting it to here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna start over,
you gotta do it from your hometown, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I guess I want to forget about how small and awkward I felt as a kid,
and try living happily all over again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I feel like I'm missing out on so much of my hometown's charm, too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's what you meant♪
Sounds good, looks great☆
Well then, Trainer, I'll drop by again during the summer!

And so, another trip to Hokkaido was decided.
This time, not for a race, but purely for fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hokkaido in the summer, huh... Hmm, what should I do?
Back in the day, I was always doing intense training camps
with everyone from the Mejiro family, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I want to make sure once more.
What kind of place my hometown is.
And what kind of Umamusume... I am!"
Before next year's Nikkei Shinshun Hai, let's first check in on how Mejiro Palmer truly feels.
